name: io.github.charles-verdict/verdict-finance-mcp
title: Verdict: the due-diligence house for DeFi
description: Verdict, the due-diligence house for DeFi: keyless ratings, methodology and a hack incident feed.

tools.name: search_ratings
tools.task: Find rated entities by name or keyword across all seven types

tools.name: get_rating
tools.task: Letter grade and composite score for one protocol, chain, token, oracle, vault, organisation or bridge

tools.name: list_ratings
tools.task: Browse a rated set best-first, filtered by category or chain

tools.name: quantum_readiness
tools.task: Post-quantum cryptographic readiness for a chain, or the full league table

tools.name: get_recent_incidents
tools.task: DeFi hack incidents, newest first (confirmed by default), pollable with a since cursor

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.task: How a grade is produced: criteria counts and domains per entity type, and the AAA to D scale

tools.name: get_rating_breakdown
tools.task: Per-domain scores behind one entity's grade (needs VERDICT_API_KEY)

tools.name: request_coverage
tools.task: Ask Verdict to rate an entity it does not cover yet

useCases: Check what Verdict rates a DeFi protocol before allocating to it
Screen a portfolio's chains, oracles and bridges for dependency risk
Poll a hack incident feed to drive an agent's risk workflow
Explain a grade from the published methodology and its domain breakdown
